sources.notes: Uses Dorfiella knowltonii, treating Hydropteris pinnata as a taxonomic synonym and Hydropteris as an illegitimate homonym. Simple appendage interpretations remain disputed: floats, sporocarps or reduced fronds.

reconstruction_notes.en: Round junction structures are artistic, possibly sporocarp-like appendages; their function is uncertain. Competing fossil interpretations include floats, sporocarps and reduced fronds.

name.en: Dorfiella knowltonii water fern (historically Hydropteris pinnata)
name.zh: Dorfiella knowltonii 羽叶水蕨（旧称 Hydropteris pinnata）

description.en: Original stylized-inspired static water-fern art, using Dorfiella knowltonii following Hermsen (2025); Hydropteris pinnata is the historical 1994 name. Round junction structures are an artistic interpretation of uncertain, possibly sporocarp-like appendages, not confirmed reproductive organs. Colors, pose and nominal dimensions are artistic.
description.zh: 原创风格化静态水蕨美术，名称遵循 Hermsen（2025）的 Dorfiella knowltonii；Hydropteris pinnata 为 1994 年旧称。根茎与叶轴连接处的圆形结构，是对性质未定、可能呈孢子果状的附属结构所作的艺术解释，并非已确认的生殖器官。色彩、姿态和标称尺寸均属艺术选择。
